title: 第二十二章 飞升第二十三章 强行推广义务教育
content_zh:
这话是真扎心啊！北空明转头问：“你听到没，抬头看看，这十里人头灯，真不差你们胡家这些通敌叛国的人的命。只是，你们的想当人头灯，真的不够资格啊，看看，这里最少也是三品大员。你们，真不配。”
韩紫枫嘿嘿嘿，嘿嘿嘿。冷幽幽的来一句：“主母啊，你死都不够资格死啊！胡家，就这，你是怎么好意思，豪横到这种程度的？”突然，紫枫很是质疑的问：“不对啊，说好的满门抄斩呢？那丫是怎么豪横的来这里给咱添堵的？这个监斩的玩忽职守啊喂。”
北空明一捂脸说：“等等，等等，抄家的，更监斩的是两份活儿，至于玩忽职守，这个罪名到时可以成立。”
紫枫吐槽：“亲，主意重点啊！丫的可以出来在大街上溜达，你觉得那个皇帝哟，会不会被刺杀什么的？毕竟，满门抄斩的人，都能四处溜达，无压力的溜达，那么护卫不是死的，就是里面有内鬼呗。”
北空明一愣，紫枫也不想多说，直接飞身上了北空明的马，抓着他再次瞬移，来到皇帝的身边，别说，他们的到来，看到的就是刺杀进行时，由于落点的问题，紫枫顿时就吐槽啦，不为别的，她整那么多人头灯都没挂彩，首杀居然被刺杀的刺客给拿走啦。
她顿时怒起来啦，就见她手成剑指在身前转了一圈，随后往后一只，飞剑有灵，知道谁叫主人受伤的，那大开杀戒就完事啦。
皇帝疑惑的问：“你们怎么刚好过来，不是要结婚的吗？”
紫枫嫌弃的说：“碰到他们的猪队友，猜你这里要有麻烦，这不赶紧过来瞧瞧，混蛋啊，能不能叫人好好的结个婚啦？混蛋，等老娘结完婚，妈d，我叫他们全部当俘虏，混蛋啊！”
皇族一群人默默看着天上乱窜的飞剑，哎，他们都无力吐槽了好吧，等刺客死完，紫枫淡定的说：“走，把人头都给我绑花轿上。安全问题，你自己处理，这个皇宫比漏勺都松快啊！打不打脸？”
确定这里没事情啦，他们才再次返回到结婚现场，一群人看着新娘，新郎，直接在花轿上绑一圈，血淋淋的人头，就算是胡青秀也不知道要干点啥？要不要这么血腥？
胡青秀咆哮：“你这个杀人狂魔，你那里有脸嫁给皇室？”
紫枫很淡定的说：“你个通敌叛国的，哪来的自信骂我，将军府的脸，都被你们胡家给丢光啦。我着十里人头灯，没一个死大凛子民，额，轿子上的人头，不知道，但刺王杀驾，嗯嗯，值得一挂。你不觉得，这样才很上官家，作为百战死的将军，十里敌人人头灯为嫁妆，这才是将军家，正常的嫁妆吧？”
各大国家的人都很想吐槽，什么叫人头灯，是正常的嫁妆？正常的嫁妆？嫁妆？额，顿时，所有人看上官武的眼神，都有点不对啦。
上官武一摊手说：“家宅内室，都归那个和离的，穿一身丧服给新人添堵的女人管。”
此时，紫枫脑袋突然就一抽，居然想起雨夜屠夫里，华叔那个经典的阴森森的笑容，于是，她突然就神还原了一把。
北空明这个皇子顿时就是一捂脸，有点不忍直视啦，这个孩子是准备告诉所有人，三皇子妃是个疯的吗？看看这个十里人头灯的场景，算啦，算啦，不疯能结婚的时候点人头灯开路？这个形象，没必要拯救啦。
第二捂脸的就是上官武，他能感觉到，自己的五闺女完全就是玩嗨啦，精神状态，还没完整调节过来而已。结果，剩下的结婚过程，全程没一个人敢废话，不为别的，看着身体还流血的某个新娘，总感觉哪里不太对的样子。
三拜完成，紫枫耳边就传来霖华仙尊的问题：“亲，任务完成，是白日飞升还是继续玩？”
紫枫点点点，很质疑的问：“不是，这样你就不怕这个孩子有心里阴影？”
霖华仙尊撇撇嘴表示：“关我屁事，反正你俩几乎是没啥可能再见面啦。”

紫枫点点点，然后开心说：“拜玩就飞升回去呗。”
霖华仙尊表示无语，紫枫吐槽：“其实，我觉得白莲花系统，更适合我姐上官菱，不过，这样就有点给这个国家添堵啦。你也能拿我这个便宜男人试试，估计就这个家伙的心里素质，应该不会死给你看吧？我给他搞出十万人头，他也没说死给我看啊！”
霖华仙尊提示：“亲，你是不是忘记啥了，是不是忘记啥啦？你的武器配方呢？”
紫枫淡定的回答：“简单，你把我那个倒霉男人也提拔成体验员，然后直接反手当新手大礼包呗。”
霖华仙尊吐槽：“你信不信，再见面那个哥们一定打你的屁股。”
紫枫开心的说：“拿出你作天，作地，作死所有体验员的本事，往嗨里玩呗。一个世界的气运，基础点我都给他们铺的差不多啦，但凡有点皇帝头脑的，他就能玩出一统江山。”
霖华仙尊能说啥？安排。紫枫淡定的给这个神仙一刀：“但凡叫我碰上他，肯定是你暗箱操作，切，小心本宝宝打击报复。”
霖华仙尊无语的问：“亲，你不觉得，你有神经病的潜质吗？”
紫枫回答：“事实证明，你发的系统，只有神经病玩的转，扎心不？再说，人家就玩的比较嗨，更神经病差的有点远吧？最多人家就是暴躁一点点，谁叫他们给我添堵的。”
霖华仙尊已经感觉到，无力吐槽啦，就这样吧。所以拜完天地，众人就看新娘子凭空飞起，然后，就这么再大家的面前消失掉，消失，失。
北空明感觉，这个妞从头到尾，就是开玩笑的吧？是吧？他磨牙啊，是真磨牙啊，太无视他了，太欺负他了。
就在这个时候，霖华仙尊淡定的补一刀：“叮，你的夫人上官枫，推荐你成为系统体验员，是否参与？”
content_en:
This is really heartbreaking! Beikong Ming turned around and asked: "Did you hear that? Look up and see that these ten-mile headlamps are really worth the lives of those of you Hu family who collaborate with the enemy and treason. However, you are really not qualified to be a human headlamp. Look, here are at least third-grade officials. You are really unworthy."
Han Zifeng hehehehehehehehe. Leng said quietly: "Mother, you are not qualified to die! The Hu family, just like this, how can you have the nerve to be so arrogant?" Suddenly, Zifeng asked very doubtfully: "No, what about the whole family that we agreed to kill? Then how did you come here so arrogantly to cause trouble for us? This supervisor has neglected his duty."
Beikong Mingyi covered his face and said: "Wait, wait, the person who ransacked the house is actually doing two jobs. As for dereliction of duty, this crime can be established by then."
Zifeng complained: "Dear, that's the point! You can go out and walk on the street. Do you think the emperor will be assassinated or something? After all, people who have been slaughtered can walk around without any pressure, so the guards are either dead or there is a mole inside."
Beikong Ming was stunned, and Zifeng didn't want to say anything. He flew directly onto Beikong Ming's horse, grabbed him and teleported again, and came to the emperor's side. Not to mention, when they arrived, what they saw was the assassination in progress. Due to the problem of the landing point, Zifeng immediately complained. For no other reason, she didn't even bother to take advantage of so many people, and the first kill was actually taken away by the assassin.
She suddenly became angry, and saw her hand turned into a sword and turned in a circle in front of her, and then moved back with a flying sword. If she knew who caused the owner to be injured, she would start a killing spree.
The emperor asked doubtfully: "Why did you just come here? Aren't you going to get married?"
Zifeng said with disgust: "I met their pig teammates, I guess you are going to be in trouble here, why don't you come over and have a look, bastard, can you ask someone to get married properly? Bastard, wait until I get married, damn, I will make them all prisoners, bastard!"
A group of people from the royal family silently looked at the flying swords flying in the sky. Hey, they couldn't complain anymore. After the assassin was dead, Zifeng said calmly: "Let's go and tie all the heads to the sedan chair. You can handle the safety issue yourself. This palace is looser than a colander! Can't you slap me in the face?"
After making sure that nothing happened here, they returned to the wedding scene again. A group of people watched the bride and groom being tied directly to the sedan chair with bloody heads. Even Hu Qingxiu didn't know what to do? Do you want it to be so bloody?
Hu Qingxiu roared: "You murderer, how dare you marry the royal family?"
Zifeng said calmly: "You collaborator and treason, how can you have the confidence to scold me? The face of the General's Palace has been completely disgraced by your Hu family. I have ten miles of headlights, and not one of the Dalin people has died, uh, the heads on the sedan chair." , I don’t know, but assassinating the king, eh, it’s worth mentioning. Don’t you think that this is a normal dowry for a general who has died in hundreds of battles, and the heads of enemies from ten miles away are used as dowries?”
People from all major countries want to complain, what is a head lamp and a normal dowry? A normal dowry? dowry? Well, suddenly, everyone looked at Shangguan Wu and felt something was wrong.
Shangguan Wu spread his hands and said, "The inner rooms of the house are all under the control of the woman who is married to Heli. She wears mourning clothes and creates trouble for the newlyweds."
At this moment, Zifeng's head suddenly twitched, and she remembered Uncle Hua's classic sinister smile in The Butcher on a Rainy Night, so she suddenly regained consciousness.
The prince Beikong Ming immediately covered his face and couldn't bear to look at it. Is this child planning to tell everyone that the third prince's concubine is crazy? Look at this scene of ten miles of headlamps, forget it, forget it, if you’re not crazy, can you light up your headlamps to clear the way when you’re getting married? There is no need to save this image.
The second person to cover his face is ShangguanWu, he could feel that his fifth daughter was just having fun, and her mental state had not yet fully adjusted. As a result, no one dared to talk nonsense during the rest of the wedding process. For no other reason than looking at a certain bride who was still bleeding, she always felt that something was not right.
After completing the three worships, Linhua Immortal Lord's question came to Zifeng's ears: "Dear, the mission is completed. Should I ascend in the daytime or continue playing?"
Zifeng nodded and asked doubtfully: "No, so you are not afraid that this child will have a shadow in his heart?"
Immortal Linhua curled his lips and said: "It's none of my business. Anyway, there is almost no chance that you two will meet again."
Zifeng nodded, and then said happily: "I'll fly back if I want to play."
Immortal Linhua was speechless, and Zifeng complained: "Actually, I think the White Lotus system is more suitable for my sister Shangguan Ling, but this will cause a bit of trouble for this country. You can also try it on a cheap man like me. I guess this guy's mental quality will not kill him for you, right? I gave him 100,000 people, but he didn't say he would die for me!"
Immortal Linhua reminded: "Dear, have you forgotten something? Have you forgotten something? Where is your weapon formula?"
Zifeng replied calmly: "It's simple, you promote my unlucky man to an experimenter, and then directly use it as a gift package for novices."
Immortal Linhua complained: "Believe it or not, that buddy will definitely spank you when we meet again."
Zifeng said happily: "Use your ability to control the sky, the earth, and kill all the experiencers, and have fun. I have already laid out the basic points for them about the luck of a world. Anyone with an emperor's mind can unify the country."
What can Immortal Linhua say? arrange. Zifeng calmly gave this god a knife: "If I encounter him, you will definitely be operating behind the scenes. Be careful of my baby's retaliation."
Immortal Linhua asked speechlessly: "Dear, don't you think you have the potential to be mentally ill?"
Zifeng replied: "It turns out that the system you developed can only be played by lunatics. Isn't it heart-breaking? Besides, people have a lot of fun playing, so the more lunatic ones are a bit far behind, right? At most, they are a little bit irritable. Who asked them to cause trouble for me?"
Linhua Immortal Lord has already felt that he can't complain, so let's leave it at that. So after worshiping the heaven and earth, everyone watched the bride fly up out of thin air, and then just disappear in front of everyone, disappear, and be lost.
Beikong Ming felt that this girl was just joking from beginning to end, right? Right? He was grinding his teeth, he was really grinding his teeth. He was ignoring him too much and bullying him too much.
At this time, Immortal Linhua calmly added: "Ding, your wife Shangguan Feng recommends you to become a system experiencer. Do you want to participate?"
